units.title: Weight unit
units.hint: Used for every weight in the logger, history, routines and the share card. Weights are stored in kg, so you can switch any time and your old numbers stay the same.

table.timerStop: Stop and save time of set {{label}}

measure.label: How {{name}} is measured
measure.confirmMessage: The reps or time of every set of this exercise are cleared and the set ticks are removed. Weight and set types stay.
measure.confirmMessageRoutine: The reps or time of every set of this exercise are replaced with the starting numbers. Weight and set types stay.

info.custom: This is your own exercise, so only its muscles are recorded.

rpe.title: RPE
rpe.hint: How hard the set was, from 6 (easy) to 10 (nothing left).

rest.over: Rest is over, on to the next set
rest.title: Rest timer: {{name}}
rest.saveHint: This exercise will always use that time.

notification.title: Rest is over
notification.askTitle: Tell you when rest is over?
notification.askMessage: If the screen is off or you are in another app, JoyoFit can send a notification when the rest timer ends.

liveRest.channel: Rest timer on the lock screen
liveRest.title: Rest

toast.saveFailed: The workout was not saved. Try again.

banner.title: Workout in progress
banner.label: Workout in progress, {{time}}, {{progress}}. Tap to open

active.emptyBody: Add your first exercise to start logging sets.
active.notesHint: Add a note for this workout

hr.searchingA11y: Looking for the heart rate strap
hr.waitingA11y: Strap connected, no heart rate yet
hr.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is off, so the heart rate strap is not connected. The workout is still logged with estimated calories.

ask.title: Use your heart rate strap?
ask.body: {{name}} is paired. JoyoFit needs Bluetooth permission to connect to it. Your heart rate is then recorded and the workout calories are worked out from it.

denied.body: Bluetooth permission was not granted, so the heart rate strap cannot connect. The workout is still logged with estimated calories. You can allow it in the app settings.

session.title: Strength training
session.text: Recording heart rate from the strap

discard.title: Discard this workout?
discard.message: Every set you logged will be lost.

finish.partialMessage_one: {{count}} set is not done and will not be saved.
finish.partialMessage_other: {{count}} sets are not done and will not be saved.
finish.nothingMessage: Tick at least one set as done to save the workout, or discard it.

edit.noSetsMessage: A workout without sets cannot be saved. Delete this workout?
edit.leaveMessage: Changes you have not saved will be lost.

conflict.title: A workout is in progress
conflict.message: You still have an unfinished workout. Continue it, or discard it and start the new one?

picker.emptyBody: Change the search or filters, or create your own exercise.
picker.deleteMessage: Workouts that used it keep their history.
picker.formMeasureHint: Reps for movements you count per rep, Time for planks and other holds. You can change it per workout later.

summary.title: Workout summary
summary.missingBody: This workout may have been deleted.
summary.deleteMessage: This workout is removed from your history and from the workout list.
summary.kcalWeightHint: Calories were estimated with a body weight of {{kg}} kg because yours is not set. Add it in Profile for a closer estimate.

settings.title: Strength settings
settings.defaultRestHint: Used when an exercise has no time of its own.
settings.autoRestHint: The timer starts when you tick a set done.
settings.countdownHint: The stopwatch of a timed set counts down from the time already entered and vibrates at zero. When off, it counts up.
settings.showRpeHint: A column to note how hard each set was.
settings.autoStravaHint: Finished workouts are sent as Weight Training once Strava is linked.
settings.savedRestEmpty: None yet. Choose "Save for this exercise" in an exercise's rest timer menu.
settings.startOnWatchHint: When you start a strength workout on the phone, the watch starts Strength training too, pauses when you pause and stops when you finish. The watch's heart rate and calories join your workout after the next sync.
settings.startOnWatchOffline: Applies while the watch is connected. It is not connected right now.
settings.startOnWatchRefused: This watch refused the start command from the phone, so it cannot be started from here. Start Strength training on the watch, JoyoFit follows automatically.
settings.startOnWatchUnsupported: This watch cannot be started from the phone. Start Strength training on the watch if you want its heart rate recorded.

watch.unconfirmed: The start command was sent to the watch, not confirmed
watch.notConnected: The watch is not connected, so the workout did not start on it. Start Strength training on the watch if you want its heart rate recorded.
watch.refused: The watch refused the start command. Start Strength training on the watch if you want its heart rate recorded.
watch.refusedCode: The watch refused the start command (code {{code}}). Start Strength training on the watch if you want its heart rate recorded.
watch.notWorn: The watch says it is not on your wrist and refused to start the workout (code {{code}}). Put it on snugly and tap Try again, or start Strength training on the watch if you want its heart rate recorded.
watch.lost: This workout was started on the watch before the app restarted, so it cannot be stopped from here. Stop it on the watch when you finish.
watch.gated: This watch cannot be started from the phone. Start Strength training on the watch, JoyoFit follows automatically.
watch.endedOnWatch: The workout stopped on the watch. Finish this one here once all sets are logged; the watch data joins after the next sync.

watchPick.title: Pick a routine
watchPick.intro: The watch is recording Strength training. Pick a routine to tick off here; the watch's heart rate and time show in the header.

plates.title: Plate calculator
plates.empty: Enter a weight for a set first, then the plates per side show here.
plates.pictureLabel: One side of the barbell with its plates
plates.belowBar: This weight is lighter than the bar ({{bar}}).
plates.inexact: Not exact. The plates reach {{reached}}, {{left}} short.
